objective: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank.

description: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.
We need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.
progress: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
completion: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

Hmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
